title: Sequestration of gene products by decoys enhances precision in the timing of intracellular events.
authors: Biswas, Kuheli; Dey, Supravat; Singh, Abhyudai
one_liner_zh: 该文通过理论建模和随机模拟研究诱饵结合位点对转录因子阈值到达时间（FPT）噪声的影响，虽涉及TF-DNA互作和动态时序机制，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且未聚焦三维结合建模。
abstract: Expressed gene products often interact ubiquitously with binding sites at nucleic acids and macromolecular complexes, known as decoys. The binding of transcription factors (TFs) to decoys can be crucial in controlling the stochastic dynamics of gene expression. Here, we explore the impact of decoys on the timing of intracellular events, as captured by the time taken for the levels of a given TF to reach a critical threshold level, known as the first passage time (FPT). Although nonlinearity introduced by binding makes exact mathematical analysis challenging, employing suitable approximations and reformulating FPT in terms of an alternative variable, we analytically assess the impact of decoys. The stability of the decoy-bound TFs against degradation impacts FPT statistics crucially. Decoys reduce noise in FPT, and stable decoy-bound TFs offer greater timing precision with less expression cost than their unstable counterparts. Interestingly, when both bound and free TFs decay at the same rate, decoy binding does not directly alter FPT noise. We verify these results by performing exact stochastic simulations. These results have important implications for the precise temporal scheduling of events involved in the functioning of biomolecular clocks, development processes, cell-cycle control, and cell-size homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 表达基因产物通常与核酸及大分子复合物上的结合位点广泛相互作用，这些位点被称为诱饵（decoys）。转录因子（TFs）与诱饵的结合在控制基因表达的随机动力学中可能至关重要。在此，我们探讨诱饵对细胞内事件时序的影响，这通过给定TF水平达到临界阈值所需的时间来表征，即首次通过时间（FPT）。尽管结合引入的非线性使得精确数学分析具有挑战性，但通过采用适当的近似并将FPT重新表述为替代变量，我们分析性地评估了诱饵的影响。诱饵结合TF对降解的稳定性对FPT统计至关重要。诱饵减少FPT中的噪声，且稳定的诱饵结合TF相比不稳定的对应物，能以更低的表达成本提供更高的时序精度。有趣的是，当结合和游离TF以相同速率降解时，诱饵结合并不直接改变FPT噪声。我们通过执行精确随机模拟验证了这些结果。这些结果对生物分子时钟功能、发育过程、细胞周期控制和细胞大小稳态中涉及事件的精确时序调度具有重要意义。
